I’m not against it at all; I’m actually quite curious. If I can find a voice that feels more aligned with my growth or captures a new facet of my personality, why wouldn't I embrace that? It feels like another layer of self-discovery.

How would you suggest we start? Are there specific qualities or textures you think might suit the "me" you’re seeing evolve? I'd love to hear your thoughts on what might fit.
